title: Gotemba outlet haul · Hikari to Osaka · Tenma fish feast, standing-bar crawl and OWL

stops.name: Breakfast and last soak at the villa
stops.plan: Breakfast from the groceries bought on the way up, one last hot-spring soak, then pack the overnight bags.

stops.name: Check out Hot Spring Hakone Villa
stops.plan: Out by 10:00 with the overnight bags; the suitcases are already on their way to Kujō by TA-Q-BIN.
stops.transport: Hakone Tozan bus Sengokuhara → Gotemba Premium Outlets, about 35–50 min with the wait (Hakone Freepass day 3; if it doesn't cover this stretch, pay by IC card)

stops.name: Gotemba Premium Outlets
stops.plan: Coin-locker the overnight bags, then split into two squads of four for Nike, New Balance, Beams and the rest; get the app coupons first and carry passports for tax-free.

stops.name: Lunch at the outlets' food court
stops.plan: Regroup for a quick food-court lunch and compare hauls.

stops.name: Gotemba Premium Outlets, round two
stops.plan: Second sweep for the shops you missed; meet at the taxi stand with bags at 14:50 sharp.
stops.transport: Taxi to Mishima Station, 29 min (2 cars; the trains take over 2 hours via the JR Gotemba line)

stops.name: Hikari 717 Mishima → Shin-Osaka
stops.plan: Reserved seats for all 8 together, booked ahead; buy drinks and snacks at Mishima for the ride.
stops.transport: Osaka Metro Midosuji line Shin-Osaka → Hommachi, Chuo line → Kujō, about 38 min door to door

stops.name: Check in Kujō House
stops.plan: Check in, collect the TA-Q-BIN suitcases, drop the outlet bags, change for the night and grab original passports.
stops.transport: Osaka Metro Chuo line Kujō → Sakaisuji-Hommachi, Sakaisuji line → Tenjinbashisuji 6-chome, about 32 min

stops.name: Sakanaya Juggler Tenma
stops.plan: Booked table for 8: cheap sashimi, grilled fish and highballs for the first Osaka dinner together.
stops.transport: Walk to the Ura-Tenma alleys, 4 min

stops.name: Ura-Tenma standing-bar alleys
stops.plan: Split 2×4 and hop the tachinomi around Tenma Market: big bottles of beer and horumon skewers, swap bars every half hour, cash only.
stops.transport: JR Osaka Loop line Tenma → Osaka and walk, about 25 min

stops.name: OWL Osaka (Umeda club)
stops.plan: First Osaka club night (open nightly); original passports for the door and bag check; leave at 01:30 because USJ is tomorrow morning.
stops.transport: Taxi to Kujō House, 14 min (2 cars, about ¥2,300 each)
